subject: POC prompt dataset collection & evaluation plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmecorp.com>, Bob Lee <bob.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt dataset collection & evaluation plan

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC moving:

1) Success criteria (proposal)
   - Top-line: Achieve >= 90% intent/slot match on labeled dev set OR show a 40% relative reduction in manual routing for your support flows (whichever is most business-aligned).
   - Latency: median response time <= 250ms for 1–2 token responses under test load.
   - Cost: target per-1k-token inference cost within the committed budget band we discussed.

2) Evaluation plan & ownership
   - You to provide: prompt set + anonymized historical logs (preferred CSV) and a small labeled dev set for gold evaluation. See attached sample template. [Attachment: POC_sample_prompt_template.csv (CSV, 2KB)]
   - Redwood: Rishi will run the eval harness, produce token-level metrics, and produce a candidate tuning/quantization plan.
   - Timeline: we propose intake by May 2, initial eval/metrics by May 9, and a joint review week of May 11–13.

3) Data/PII guidance
   - Please scrub any direct PII from logs before sending. If you prefer, we can provide a minimal script to help with scrubbing. If security needs to review, loop in security@acmecorp.com.

4) Next steps / asks for ACME
   - Send a 2–3k prompt sample (CSV) following the attached template + any labeled examples for success criteria by EOD May 2.
   - Confirm the primary success metric (intent accuracy vs reduction in manual routing).

Rishi / Dev — I’m assigning Rishi as Redwood lead for running the evaluation and Dev to support ingestion (formatting/ETL). I’ll follow up with a shared Drive link and a HubSpot activity.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: POC_sample_prompt_template.csv]

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — this looks good. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can deliver a scrubbed sample of historical prompts/logs. Our security team asked that we remove any usernames and replace emails with tokens; we will deliver a scrubbing manifest along with the dataset. Expect a CSV attachment similar to your template.
- For success metric: leadership prefers a business outcome metric — reduction in manual routing/hand-offs in the support flow. We'll provide a small labeled set that maps messages -> routing decision so you can evaluate end-to-end.
- Timeline: team is tight but we can target May 2 for initial dataset delivery. We'll attach the file and manifest separately.

Attached: preliminary export (PII scrubbed). Please confirm receipt and whether you need additional fields (customer id token, channel).

Thanks,
Alice
Product Manager, AcmeCorp
